title: US court refuses to immediately drop Adani indictment, says DoJ didn't give adequate reasons
description: A United States federal court has refused to immediately allow the Department of Justice (DoJ) to drop criminal charges against Gautam Adani, Sagar Adani and others in the alleged $250 million bribery case, after finding that the government’s explanation for doing so was “terse, bland, and conclusory.” [United States v. Gautam S Adani et al]Judge Nicholas G Garaufis of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York directed the DoJ to give reasons for its decision to seek
